title: Ghosts of Mississippi
description: A Mississippi prosecutor (Alec Baldwin) and the widow (Whoopi Goldberg) of Medgar Evers crusade to retry a white racist (James Woods) for the 1963 murder of the NAACP leader.

title: Boiler Room
description: Eager to win the approval of his demanding father, a young man (Giovanni Ribisi) begins working for a dubious stock firm.

title: Tenacious D in: The Pick of Destiny
description: Musicians JB (Jack Black) and KG (Kyle Gass) form rock group Tenacious D and set out on a quest for a legendary guitar pick that will make them the greatest band in the world.

title: Deep Cover
description: An undercover officer (Larry Fishburne) hooks up with a lawyer (Jeff Goldblum) who deals drugs for a West Coast cartel run by a foreign diplomat.

title: Over the Edge
description: A heroin addict sees a body fall past his window and goes outside to investigate.

title: Mama's Boy
description: A 29-year-old slacker (Jon Heder) who still lives with his mother (Diane Keaton) takes action when a self-help guru (Jeff Daniels) threatens his perfect world.

title: 8 Seconds
description: Lane Frost is a cowboy who rises to become a professional bull-riding champion in the 1980s. Along the way, he endures injuries and the ups and downs of married life.

title: Honeymoon in Vegas
description: A Las Vegas gambler (James Caan) wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's (Nicolas Cage) bride (Sarah Jessica Parker) during a convention of Elvis impersonators.

title: Who's That Girl?
description: A hapless New Yorker's (Griffin Dunne) rich future father-in-law orders him to escort a bleached blonde (Madonna) out of town.

title: Message in a Bottle
description: A woman (Robin Wright Penn) learns that the author of a romantic note that washed ashore is a shipbuilder (Kevin Costner) whose wife died young and tragically.

title: Sphere
description: A psychologist (Dustin Hoffman), a biochemist (Sharon Stone), a mathematician (Samuel L. Jackson) and others investigate a large golden sphere deep in the ocean.

title: Singles
description: A group of young adults in a Seattle apartment building faces a series of romantic crises and catastrophes.

title: My Giant
description: A sleazy showbiz agent (Billy Crystal) tries to exploit a very large, gentle man (Gheorghe Muresan) he discovered in a Romanian monastery.

title: Private Benjamin
description: A pampered Jewish widow (Goldie Hawn) is tricked into joining the Army and unexpectedly finds a new sense of purpose and self-worth.

title: Death to Smoochy
description: Fired from his children's show, a former star (Robin Williams) tries to kill his replacement, a man (Edward Norton) dressed in a rhinoceros suit.

title: The Dukes of Hazzard: The Beginning
description: Bo (Jonathan Bennett), Luke (Randy Wayne) and Daisy Duke try to prevent Boss Hogg from seizing Uncle Jesse's (Willie Nelson) farm.

title: Guilty by Suspicion
description: During the 1950s anti-Communist witch-hunts, a film director's career and personal life begin crumbling after he is accused of communist ties and blacklisted.

title: The Island of Dr. Moreau
description: An English U.N. negotiator (David Thewlis) becomes stranded in the tropics with a mad scientist (Marlon Brando) who makes half-human beasts.

title: Monkey Trouble
description: A 9-year-old (Thora Birch) learns her new pet monkey worked as a pickpocket for a Gypsy hustler (Harvey Keitel).

title: The Hudsucker Proxy
description: A scheming executive promotes a mailroom worker to company president in the 1950s Manhattan.

title: Transcendence
description: A scientific genius's (Johnny Depp) controversial attempts to create a sentient machine take an unforeseen turn after he is mortally wounded during an attack by anti-technology radicals.

title: Joe Versus the Volcano
description: A dying man (Tom Hanks) meets three women (Meg Ryan) on his way to Polynesia, where a tycoon (Lloyd Bridges) expects him to jump into a volcano.

title: Arthur
description: A dry British butler (John Gielgud) helps his tippling master (Dudley Moore) choose love with a waitress (Liza Minnelli) or marriage for money.

title: Club Paradise
description: A Chicago firefighter (Robin Williams) and a reggae musician (Jimmy Cliff) turn a Caribbean dive into a swinging-singles resort.

title: Hooper
description: An upstart (Jan-Michael Vincent) pushes a veteran Hollywood stuntman (Burt Reynolds), daring him to try a new stunt.

title: The Jacket
description: Cared for by a physician (Kris Kristofferson), an amnesiac Gulf War veteran (Adrien Brody) has violent flashbacks and visions of the future.

title: City by the Sea
description: A New York homicide detective (Robert De Niro) searches for his son (James Franco), the prime suspect in the murder of a drug dealer.

title: Grilled
description: Two down-on-their-luck meat salesmen (Ray Romano, Kevin James) land in hot water when their "foolproof" scheme backfires.

title: Lady in the Water
description: A building manager rescues an enigmatic young woman and learns that she is a "narf," a character from a bedtime story, who is trying to return to her world.

title: Pleasantville
description: A shy suburban teen and his sister are transported into the black-and-white world of a 1950s TV sitcom.

title: New York Minute
description: An uptight teenager (Ashley Olsen) and her laid-back twin (Mary-Kate Olsen) spend a wild day on the streets of Manhattan.

title: Chaos Theory
description: After his wife (Emily Mortimer) plays a prank on him, an efficiency expert (Ryan Reynolds) finds himself subject to the random nature of life.

title: Nothing but Trouble
description: Four trendy New Yorkers face a crazed judge and other horrors in the village of Valkenvania.

title: Ready to Rumble
description: Two die-hard fans vow to help wrestler Jimmy the King make a comeback after a loss destroys what was left of his career.

title: Mr. Nanny
description: As a favor to his former trainer (Sherman Hemsley), a retired wrestler (Terry "Hulk" Hogan) takes a job as a computer tycoon's (Austin Pendleton) bodyguard.

title: I Am Sam
description: A man (Sean Penn) with the mental capacity of a child hires a lawyer (Michelle Pfeiffer) to regain custody of his daughter.

title: Osmosis Jones
description: One white blood cell's race against the biological clock to hunt down and destroy a lethal new virus.

title: Arthur
description: An irresponsible playboy (Russell Brand) must choose between an arranged marriage that will ensure his future wealth or following his heart with a woman (Greta Gerwig) he truly loves.

title: Midnight Cabaret
description: Satanic aspects of a Broadway show are reflected in the life of an actress (Laura Herrington) who is in it.

title: Wildcats
description: A famous coach's daughter (Goldie Hawn) coaches boys football at a city high school patrolled by dogs.

title: Cannonball Run II
description: J.J. McClure (Burt Reynolds), his mechanic (Dom DeLuise) and other veteran competitors enter another cross-country auto race.

title: After the Sunset
description: An FBI agent (Woody Harrelson) thinks a master thief (Pierce Brosnan) and his girlfriend (Salma Hayek) will try to steal a valuable diamond from a cruise ship.

title: Funny Farm
description: A sportswriter (Chevy Chase) and his wife (Madolyn Smith) move to a cottage in the country, where he tries to write a novel.
